definitions.explanation: The eleventh month of the year. Late autumn with peak foliage in many areas and the Shichi-Go-San festival for children.

examples.japanese: {十一月|じゅういちがつ}は{紅葉|もみじ}がきれいです。
examples.english: The autumn leaves are beautiful in November.

examples.japanese: {十一月|じゅういちがつ}は{寒|さむ}くなります。
{十一月|じゅういちがつ}に{七五三|しちごさん}があります。

notes: November is literally 'month eleven.' Shichi-Go-San (七五三, 'Seven-Five-Three') on November 15th is a festival celebrating children aged 3, 5, and 7. Autumn foliage reaches its peak in many areas during November.
